1982 relaunch of small figures, vehicles, file cards, and a shared Cobra war.

How G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero connects

  • Faction: Hasbro — Hasbro relaunched G.I. Joe as A Real American Hero in 1982.
  • Topic: G.I. Joe — A Real American Hero is the core modern continuity of G.I. Joe.
  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — The G.I. Joe team is the hero roster of A Real American Hero.
  • Faction: Cobra — Cobra is the enemy organization of A Real American Hero.
  • Event: 1982 G.I. Joe relaunch — The 1982 relaunch created the A Real American Hero continuity.
  • Item: File cards — File cards are the printed dossiers of the Real American Hero line.
  • Work: G.I. Joe (1964) — The 12-inch soldier came before the 3¾-inch Real American Hero line.
  • Work: G.I. Joe (Marvel comic) — The Marvel comic adapts and extends A Real American Hero.
  • Series: G.I. Joe (Sunbow series) — The Sunbow series adapts A Real American Hero for television.

What is G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero?

A Real American Hero is the 1982 G.I. Joe continuity: swivel-arm figures, file-card bios, the Pit, Cobra, and the Marvel comic and Sunbow cartoon that made 'Yo Joe!' the team's shout.

Key threads lead to Hasbro, G.I. Joe, G.I. Joe team, Cobra, 1982 G.I. Joe relaunch and File cards.
